## Line 420

```plato

    // The rectangle grown by `amount` on every side (the Minkowski sum with a
    // square of half-width `amount`; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Minkowski_addition).
    GrowBounds(b: Bounds2D, amount: Number): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(b.Min.X - amount, b.Min.Y - amount),
            Point2D(b.Max.X + amount, b.Max.Y + amount));
```

    // The box grown by `amount` on every side.
    GrowBounds(b: Bounds3D, amount: Number): Bounds3D
        => (Point3D(b.Min.X - amount, b.Min.Y - amount, b.Min.Z - amount),
            Point3D(b.Max.X + amount, b.Max.Y + amount, b.Max.Z + amount));
